properties.name: P/3075/12
properties.site-address: Kenton Lane, 323, Kenton Lane Farm, (Braziers Farm), Harrow
properties.notes: Demolition of existing modern warehouse and non-listed former dairy storage building, extensions incorporating refridgeration units, canopy & cages, telecoms mast and associated plant/structures; alterations to Grade II Listed farmhouse to provide two self-contained residential units; conversion and alterations to Grade II Listed former dairy courtyard outbuildings to create three self-contained residential units and ancilliary commercial/workshop space; and construction of 27 two storey with habitable roofspace residential dwellings, retention of two vehicular accesses; associated car and cycle parking, refuse storage facilities, landscaping and creation of new public open space.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
